Visualization isn’t positive thinking.
It’s preparation.

Elite pitchers don’t just hope for results —
they rehearse them.

They see the seams.
They feel the spin.
They watch the pitch leave their hand exactly the way they intend.
They see the swing and miss.
The pop-up.
The dirt lift behind the catcher’s glove.

That mental rep tells the body what to do
before the moment ever arrives.

This is why, over eight years ago,
I wrote the Mindful Pitching book —
and why it’s still one of the most powerful tools
a pitcher can use on the mound.

Now that training lives inside the app
as part of the Pitching IQ Engine.

Train your mind like you train your arm.

caption:
This fall has been a journey.
It started with so much excitement and momentum… and then life took an unexpected turn. I lost my grandma and soon after realized I wouldn’t be playing the sport I love this season.

Through it all, God has continued to show me that none of this caught Him by surprise. Looking back, I see how He was preparing my heart long before this moment, last year, and even before that. I may have lost softball for this season, but I haven’t lost what matters most. I haven’t lost who I am.

My identity was never in a jersey; it’s in Jesus Christ.
And because of that, I move forward with great expectation for what God still has in store. Even though this season didn’t look how I imagined, I trust Him more than anything in this world, knowing His plan is far greater than my own.
Jeremiah 29:11🤍

athlete.bio: A fierce competitor with a relentless drive, this outside hitter blends agility and precision, dominating the court. Off the field, her infectious laughter and unwavering positivity inspire teammates to elevate their game.

caption:
And with that, I am done with my volleyball career! I have learned so much throughout the years, met some of the most amazing people, and traveled the entire country. The 11 year old Brynn would be so proud to see all that she has accomplished. Here are some life lessons I have learned that I will be taking into the next chapter of my life:
1. Always bet on yourself 
2. Get out of your comfort zone 
3. What is meant to be will be 

Thank you if you have followed my journey. I have been showered with love and support throughout my career and am so thankful for my parents, family and coaches who have all poured countless hours into my career that has catapulted my life in ways I never imagined. 

God has really guided me throughout my life and career and I am extremely blessed and overly thankful for every experience and lesson I have been through. Here’s to a new chapter and a new beginning!🥳

athlete.name: Camdyn Stucky
athlete.bio: A tenacious defender with an eye for strategy, this Tennessee standout thrives under pressure. Known for relentless hustle and a fierce competitive spirit, they embody the heart of their team.

caption:
I never thought this time would come, but the Lord has shown me that I need to continue my college volleyball career at a new home. 

I could not be more grateful for everything this program has taught me as a player and a person. I take so much pride in being a Lady Vol and always will. After redshirting last year and then being injured this season, I’ve had to learn some tough lessons that have shaped me into a much stronger women. 

I want to thank the staff here at Tennessee for all of the work and opportunities they have blessed me with. I have been given so much here and will never take that for granted.  To my teammates, thank you for letting me in and allowing me to develop some of the most special friendships I have ever had. You girls kept me joyful❤️ 

I’m ready to truly start my four years of eligibility in a new place and to take this step of faith and trust that God knows exactly what he is doing. thank you @vol_vball

athlete.name: Cate Schnell
athlete.bio: A relentless competitor, this outside hitter blends finesse and power, captivating fans with precise swings and strategic play. Her spirited leadership and unwavering determination inspire teammates to elevate their game.

caption:
It’s hard to put into words what this program and these girls mean to me. Being a Lady Vol has shaped me in ways I’ll carry forever on and off the court. Through the highs, the lows, the battles, the breakthroughs, and everything in between, this place has taught me resilience, faith, discipline, and the true importance of team.

To my teammates: thank you for the memories, the laughter, the tough love, the long days, and the unforgettable moments. I will forever be grateful for each relationship and every lesson learned alongside you. To the coaches, staff, and everyone behind the scenes — thank you for challenging me, pushing me to be resilient, and giving me the opportunity to represent a brand far bigger than myself. 

After three years of prayer and reflection on my time here, I’ve decided to enter the transfer portal to pursue a new chapter. This is not a goodbye to the memories or the love I have for this place and these people — just a step toward what’s next.

Tennessee will always have a special place in my heart. Forever grateful to be a LVFL.
Romans 8:28
🤍🩵🧡

caption:
For nearly 20 years I was fortunate enough to pour my own blood, sweat, tears and joy into this Game as an athlete. For the next Decade I became so blessed with training athletes to chase after similar passions of mine and help them achieve their dreams. Now I’m lucky enough, beyond beyond blessed, to help the College Athletes grow their passions into something bigger. If you’re the College Athlete reading this - I want to help YOU.
.
Normally I seek out Pitchers & Athletes very seldomly throughout the years to join the team; which consequently means I’m missing out on so many of you who are on the journey I once took part in. What ever it is that you think I can help you with, or why ever you’d see it as a positive to join the team - comment “College” and I’ll send you the link to apply 🤩
.
This is not you paying for anything at all, this is me helping you 💕 as we continue to grow the game for the next generation of Softball Players. 
.
.
.

caption: DJ Pauldo, father of Dynamic Duo and high school sensations Mia and Mya Pauldo, also known as (TBC) TwinBackCourt has been nothing short of the driving force behind the success of his twins throughout their young basketball careers. We often highlight and prioritize success of the talent ( & rightfully so ), but behind every special talent and great story there is usually that someone(s) behind the scenes pouring into that talent…and DJ,  New Jersey native - Paterson to be exact- is the clearest example of that. He knew from the start of their journeys how special they were and he let nothing or no one get in the way of the bright futures he saw for his two daughters. Though the path came with its many obstacles, DJ not only helped them achieve and accomplish what he knew they were capable of but also most would agree that he did it his way: creating his own AAU program ( HUrban Legends of NJ ) ,continuing to be that hands on force and leader for their paths, building their social platforms organically that led to them being the youngest brand ambassadors of a major shoe brand at the time, all while going against the grain, never wavering, and being very publicly vocal about how special he knew Mia and Mya were, anywhere, and at any cost. The list of accomplishments are lengthy to say the least, both being ranked in the top 100 ranked by ESPN, leading their HS Morris Catholic to a astonishing record of 109-6 in their four years of playing. 3 time state champions, which included a 3peat, FIRST ever OTE select league champions, 4X All conference champions, 4X All county, 4X county champions for both MIA and MYA. Both were able to accomplish, and receive a list of individual awards as well, which included  the prestigious McDonald’s all American, Gatorade player of the year award, and the list goes on. Needless to say, where they are from, they beat their odds, and by a landslide might I add. The now university of Tennessee attendees seek to continue their paths of greatness, in pursuit of achieving even greater heights 💐

From Rocky Top to Rio

Earlier this summer, Cade Phillips traveled with Tennessee’s VOLeaders Academy to Brazil for a 10-day cultural exchange trip — a dynamic service opportunity for student-athletes to refine their leadership skills on and off the court. 

The VOLeaders Academy is a first-of-its-kind program based on a year-long curriculum that provides applied leadership and service opportunities focused on community enrichment through sport. 

Through VOLeaders, Tennessee student-athletes are empowered to lead and serve through sport-based community engagement and international cultural exchange.

caption:
dear athletics mercado,

thank you. thank you for all the sacrifices you have made for me to achieve my dreams. thank you for providing me with some of my best friends. thank you to all the coaches that helped pave my path so i can reach my dreams. lastly thank you for all the support and love you have given me over the last 9 years. not a lot of people can say they have worn the same travel jersey all their career, but i can proudly say that i got the privilege of wearing the AM across my chest for all of mine. there will never be the right amount of words to describe how much this academy means to me. you have watched and help me grow into the player and person y’all knew i could become. with all the long practices, tears, sweat, grit, determination, and passion, you have helped me get ready for the next level. you helped bring back my love for the game and i will forever be grateful for that. you guys saw me at my best and most definitely my worst, but you never showed doubt. you helped me get mentally stronger and showed nothing but confidence in me. some of my best memories will be held within this academy. whether it’s the 4am wake up calls, all the delays in colorado, DTR, trio homerun hugs, every darty, flowww, every laugh, every tear, all of these memories i will forever cherish. even though i wont have the AM across my chest anymore, it will always be held in my heart. thank you for being my home. AM4L, #27 out🖤🤍

Ephesians 3:20 
- “Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,” 

God I want to thank you for giving more than what I asked for when I decided to go to Florida to play in the FGCL. It was hard knowing I would be away for so long but you gave me peace that passeth all understanding. You showed me your power and your might when I surrendered the outcome and fully trusted you. I thought I was going to play softball but I did so much more:
• Made lifelong friendships 
• Worshiped at The Beach and blessed to be apart of 
  The Holy Ghost Choir 🙌🏽
• Fell in love with softball all over again 
• Bible studies with likeminded people 
• Went fishing for the first time and caught a catfish
• Got to watch former teammates play Pro 
• Souls being saved and Baptism on the Beach 

Thank you for always looking out for me, and giving me memories of love, laughter and pure joy, Amen! 🤍

caption:
Dear Brazil 🇧🇷 — thank you for being one of the most unforgettable chapters of my college experience. You gave me the chance to grow: as a person, a leader, a teammate… and somehow, even a better dancer? 🕺😅

@voleaders , you’ve been more than a program. You’ve been a mirror, a challenge, a team, and the greatest group therapy. Over the past year, I’ve learned that leadership isn’t about titles — it’s about listening, showing up, and sometimes just being the one who keeps the energy up when everyone’s running on empty. 💧✈️
Brazil was the finale, but also the beginning. It gave me new eyes to see the world — and myself — a little more clearly. Being in a place where people have less but give more joy, more energy, more love… it shook me in the best way. Gratitude hit me like a bus or maybe a crowded São Paulo street and reminded me that life’s not about what you achieve, it’s about what you share.
To the friendships I made — y’all are stuck with me. To the laughs, the late-night talks, the deep convos-  you made the trip magic. To Brazil — thanks for reminding me to stop chasing “what’s next” and just be in the moment. And one more thing: get on your feet VOLeaders, I can’t hear you!

3 Ways to Fix Your Slice ⬇️

• Line Drill: Draw a line or place an alignment stick on the ground. Focus on striking directly along the line for consistent contact.

• Improve Your Swing Path: Your club should move slightly from the inside to out on the down swing. Think “swinging out to first base” if you are a righty. This prevents the over the top move.

• Close the Club Face: Let your hands naturally rotate through the impact zone to create a perfectly straight shot. 💯

caption:
Little late post… to be honest I wasn’t even gonna make a post like this. As time goes along and the closer I get to my next adventure the more my eyes open to reality.
 The past five years have been nothing short of amazing. I have met some people I will carry with me throughout life. The support the community has shown me and will continue to show me in Knoxville! It is so bittersweet to know that there are no more memories on that field but to know that the ones I did make are worth a life time. Coach Bush has taught me so many life lessons I will cherish forever! I was so lucky to have a once in a lifetime opportunity of going to state all four years and winning two of those times. They always say it is the legacy you leave behind that is the most important. I hope to have left the best legacy of myself I could have for the younger generations! 
 To my very best friends Gordonsville gave to me, I love you guys so so much. I hope that you guys achieve everything you ever want to!
 To my Family, thank you guys for rushing after work to watch me play. Thank you for every sacrifice you have made for me throughout these years. I can’t put into words how thankful I am to have such a great support system! I love you guys so so much!

caption:
Boise State… 

You will always hold a special place in my heart.

These past two years have been filled with growth, love, and countless blessings. From the very beginning, you welcomed me with open arms and made this place feel like home.

After much prayer and reflection, I’ve made the incredibly difficult decision to enter the transfer portal. This has been the hardest decision of my life, but I’m trusting that God is leading me into a new chapter for a reason.

To the coaches, staff, teammates, and everyone who supported me…thank you. You’ve poured into me, challenged me, and helped me become stronger both on and off the field. I’m forever grateful for every relationship and every memory.

Most importantly, I want to thank Jesus. Through Rock Harbor Church, my faith has deepened in ways I never imagined. I’ve come to know Christ in a more personal and powerful way, and I couldn’t be more thankful for how He’s moved in my life during my time here.

Boise will always be home, and I’ll carry the love, lessons, and faith I found here wherever I go.

I love you all🫶🏼 #2out

@boisestatesoftball 
@rockharbortv

caption:
Texas Tech,

Thank you for all of the great memories and amazing people. I have enjoyed my entire time being a Red Raider and this school is a place that has developed me as a human being. Tech has provided me the best 3 years I could ever ask for. Thank you for developing me into a young adult and being home to me since I was 16 years old. I have learned so much about myself and I am very happy with the person I am becoming. 

To all of the fans, thank you so much for all of your support and love for the past 3 years. You all have impacted me in many ways that I cannot explain. To all the young volleyball stars, keep working hard. You all have inspired me to be a better person and player. Thank you for all of the love you have showed to the team and I. 🫶🏽

Coaches, thank you for believing in me and allowing me to be a part of something great. I have turned into a player who I never imagined I could have been. Your dedication to not only me but to all of my teammates has been amazing and something I will FOREVER be thankful for. All of the conversations, film sessions, funny jokes and great practices will forever be in my heart.

With all of this being said, I have decided to enter the transfer portal for my final year. This decision has not been easy but I am forever thankful for this program. Thank you all for everything! ♥️

caption:
4A Softball Player to Watch: Wamego’s Peyton Hardenburger has been a standout since her freshman year for the Raiders and has racked up quite the list of SIK awards heading into her senior season. 3x 4A Pitcher of the Year, 3x 4A All State, and was a Top 9 pick and All Classes Pitcher of the Year last spring as she led the Raiders to their second straight 4A Title and had one of the most dominating seasons in Kansas history. The Tennesesse commit had a 15-1 record with a .30 ERA. She struck out 288 batters in 117 innings while also hitting .459 with 23 RBI’s on the year as one of the most complete players in the state. In the 2024 state tournament alone, Hardenburger had 63 strikeouts in 31 innings - including back to back no hitters. She also pitched the entire 17 inning history making marathon game against Clearwater where she had an astonishing 30 batters struck out in the win. Hardenberger looks to go down as one of the all time greats in Kansas high school history as she enters her senior season, “I am looking forward to starting this season off with one of our most talented groups yet! Going into my last year there is no part of me that is satisfied and I’m ready to compete again.” #sportsinkansas

אני לא יודע כל כך איך לסכם שנתיים במועדון שמזמן הפך לבית שלי, אני רק רוצה להגיד לכם תודה על הזכות לקחת חלק בחממה הכל כך מיוחדת שלנו. 
אין לי מילים לתאר את כמות החוויות שעברנו ביחד, מהנצחונות להפסדים, השמחה והדמעות. אתם הפכתם למשפחה השנייה שלי. ואני גם רוצה להודות מעומק ליבי לצוות המאמנים, צוות שחקן אמיתי, שהיו שם עבורי  מההתחלה כשהייתי ילד בן 17 שלא ממש מבין מה דרוש כדי להגיע לרמות הגבוהות יותר. תודה שהייתם סבלניים אך עקשנים שכל כך רוצים בטובתי. אני לעד אוקיר לכם תודה על הכל. 
אני יודע שהסוף המתוק שרצינו והחלום לעלות ליגה אולי לא התממש אבל המסע שעברנו במהלך השנה הזאת היה מעבר לכל הציפיות של כולם. יצא לי להכיר חברים מדהימים ואני רוצה להודות לכם שקיבלתם אותי ואפשרתם לי להיות אני, ולהיות הקפטן של הקבוצה המדהימה הזאת. אז נתניה היקרה, תודה לכם ואנחנו עוד ניפגש!
